To the friend who stayed even after seeing my worst side. To the person who never walked away when things weren’t always perfect. Some people enter our lives for a reason, but some become a part of our lives without even realising it. And you, Shakthi, are one of those rare people.

A Girl Who Started With Nothing, But Dreams of Everything.

The Beginning

A girl with dreams, determination and a world of possibilities ahead of her.

The Struggles

Balancing college, life, responsibilities and expectations. Trying to build her future without becoming a burden to her family.

The Silent Battles

Somewhere between all those responsibilities, she forgot to take care of herself. She missed her inner child, felt lonely, tired and exhausted. Sometimes she even questioned whether she was good enough for this world.

The Woman She’s Becoming

But she’s still here. Still trying. Still dreaming. Her story is nowhere near its end.

Shakthi, One Day You’ll Get There.

One day, you’ll reach the heights you’ve always dreamed of.

One day, you’ll look back at these difficult days and realise how much strength it took to become the person you are today.

You’ll conquer the world in your own way. You’ll build the life you’ve always wanted, achieve everything you’ve worked so hard for and show the world who Shakthi really is.

Until then, don’t give up on yourself.

And remember, I’m waiting to see that day. Not just to witness your success, but to celebrate every little step that brought you there.

A Letter From Chota Bheem

♥

Hi Sha,

Happy Birthday! ❤️

I hope you like this little surprise and that it brings a smile to your face today. Be happy and stay blessed.

Umm!! Where do I even start?

Honestly, I never thought that someone I met at the office would become this important to me. I initially thought you might just be another colleague, someone I’d lose touch with eventually, just like many people from school, college or work.

But you’re different.

It’s been almost two years, and you’re still here. There might have been times when I said or did things that hurt you, and I’m genuinely sorry for those moments.

But one thing I’ll always be grateful for is that you stayed.

No matter what happens, I’ll always have your back. If you ever need help, I’ll be one of the first people you can call. You never have to hesitate or think twice before asking me for anything. You have that space with me, always.

And Sha, please don’t lose your inner child.

One of the things I genuinely like about you is your innocence. I know you’re a kind-hearted person, and sometimes people might take that for granted. But don’t let that change who you are.

Stay the way you are. Stay innocent, stay kind and never stop being yourself. The right people will always value you for who you are.

And one more thing: I know you have so many dreams. I know how much you’re struggling and how hard you’re trying to build a life for yourself without putting any burden on your family.

But please remember to take care of yourself along the way. Don’t get so caught up in achieving everything that you forget to enjoy being you.

You deserve happiness just as much as you deserve success.

And listen, I don’t want any birthday treat from you right now. But when you finally land that dream job, your first treat should be for your family, and the next one is for me! 😂

You’re family to me, okay?

I’ll be waiting for the day when you achieve everything you’ve dreamed of. And when that day comes, I’ll probably be happier than you.

Until then, keep going, keep smiling and never give up on yourself.

With lots of love,

Your Best Friend,
Chota Bheem ❤️

Hey Shakthi,

The world hasn’t seen the best of you yet.

And I’ll be right here, cheering for you when it does.

— Chota Bheem ❤️
